# Skill: Implementation

## Purpose
Implement the approved story with the smallest correct scope and supporting verification.

## Description
Executes the approved plan, updates code and tests, and keeps changes aligned to requirement and architecture acceptance criteria.

## Trigger
Used by: Implementation Agent - Step 2 (Implement the Solution).

## Requires
- impl-plan.md
- requirements.md
- architecture.md

## Output Location
`outputs/<JIRA-ID>/implementation-summary.md`

## Template
```markdown
# Implementation Summary

## Changes Made
- <change 1>
- <change 2>

## Validation
- <test or verification step>

## Notes
- <implementation note>
```
